name: Technitium DNS
description: Registers your devices in Technitium DNS Server (A and reverse records) and follows address changes, after a preview and your approval. Works with a primary and secondary server and with a Technitium cluster. It only changes records it created itself and never touches records made by anything else, such as Windows machines that register themselves. Tested against a simulated server only.
author: Netlens
supports: Technitium DNS Server with primary and secondary zones (not yet tested on a real server)
Technitium DNS cluster (not yet tested on a real server)

releases.changelog: First release. Written from the official API documentation and tested against a simulated Technitium server only: please try it on a scratch zone first and report back (see the README).
